dimensions.assessment: Affects communities and institutions relying on the Assiniboine and Sioux Rural Water System and the Dry Prairie Rural Water System in Montana.
dimensions.evidence: Assiniboine and Sioux Rural Water System and the Dry Prairie Rural Water System, both located in Montana

dimensions.assessment: Extends existing planning and construction timelines rather than creating new rights or sweeping obligations.
dimensions.evidence: reauthorizes through FY2028 the planning, design, and construction

dimensions.assessment: Extends authorizations for ongoing water system projects without specifying new large-scale federal outlays beyond the continuation.
Amends a single expiration date in an existing statute to prolong ongoing project authorizations.
dimensions.evidence: Section 9 of the Fort Peck Reservation Rural Water System Act of 2000... is amended... by striking 2026 and inserting 2028

importance_detail.rationale: This bill reauthorizes funding and planning for two specific rural water systems in Montana through fiscal year 2028, representing a localized continuation of existing programs.

latest_action.text: Rules Committee Resolution H. Res. 1377 Reported to House. Rule provides for consideration of H.R. 1181, H.R. 9022, H.R. 8595 and H.R. 9237. The resolution provides for consideration of H.R. 1181 and H.R. 9237 under a closed rule and H.R. 9022 and H.R. 8595 under a structured rule. The resolution provides for one hour of general debate and one motion to recommit on each bill.
